# Infodot UK

> Infodot UK is a managed IT provider for the regulated UK industries we serve — accountancy, legal and financial services. We run IT end to end and remotely from an ISO 27001-certified team, with security built in by default and the evidence auditors, insurers and boards ask for produced as a matter of course. We run your IT. You own your IT.

Website: https://infodot.co.uk
Contact: hello@infodot.uk
Entity: Infodot Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bangalore, India — serving UK & EU remotely. Operating since 1996.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://infodot.co.uk/): Managed, secure by default, always audit-ready IT.
- [About](https://infodot.co.uk/about): Our story, delivery model and ownership/exit promise.
- [Services](https://infodot.co.uk/services): Every capability, independently buyable.
- [Pricing](https://infodot.co.uk/pricing): Engagement models — Co-Managed, Fully Managed, Fully Remote.
- [Contact](https://infodot.co.uk/contact): Book a 30-minute discovery call.

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://infodot.co.uk/industries)
- [IT support for accountants](https://infodot.co.uk/industries/accountants): IRIS, CCH, Digita, Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, FreeAgent, TaxCalc, Microsoft 365, MTD. 30-minute first response, peak-season cover, Cyber Essentials Plus / ICAEW / ACCA alignment.
- [IT support for law firms](https://infodot.co.uk/industries/law-firms): LEAP, Clio, Proclaim, PMS, document management, secure client portals. SRA-aligned security, encryption, DLP and audit trails.
- [IT support for financial services](https://infodot.co.uk/industries/financial-services): Microsoft 365, Azure, back-office/portfolio, advisory & trading, comms archiving, Entra identity. FCA operational resilience (PS26/2), DR with agreed RTO/RPO, due-diligence evidence pack.
